styleGuide.direction: A premium hand-painted fantasy settlement style combining refined storybook realism with clear RTS readability. Emberhold should feel like a resilient woodland refuge: elegant medieval construction, tactile materials, atmospheric depth, and warm human light contrasted against ash-darkened wilderness.
styleGuide.rendering: Paint with visible but controlled brush texture, soft ambient occlusion, layered material strokes, and subtle atmospheric depth. Use consistent northwest lighting, slate-blue cool shadows, ivory and copper material highlights, and localized amber glow from hearths, beacons, and fire without flattening tactical readability.
styleGuide.shapeLanguage: Use sturdy, readable silhouettes with gently irregular hand-crafted edges: steep medieval roofs, rounded timber forms, angular stonework, layered cloaks, and distinct weapon profiles. Keep linework restrained and painterly, with moderate detail concentrated on key materials, faces, heraldic shapes, and gameplay-critical features.

warnings: Faint transparency (alpha 1–8) extends into collection gutters; artwork above this threshold is intact, but inspect faint halo edges against the retained source.
